adjudication.rationale:
The diff removes the Thor CLI option `method_option :category` from `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` and deletes all logic that computed `category_id` and passed `category: category_id` into `PostCreator`, so the ability to import into a specified category is indeed dropped.

It also changes the import path from creating a post directly to `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` performs a live fetch via `open(url).read` (open-uri) and does not rescue network/HTTP errors. `disqus.thor` likewise does not wrap this call in error handling. Therefore an `OpenURI::HTTPError` (e.g., 404) would raise and can abort the whole import run.
